needs_ledger.plain: All six Instagram statement pages were captured through the registry. Because the extractor omitted or garbled carousel slide text, each saved raw HTML record has a repository transcription listing every slide.
The official seven-page FAQ and the two relevant venue pages are pinned. The data module computes all schedule counts from its 27 dated rows.

needs_ledger.need: Executed artist, promoter and venue contracts
needs_ledger.plain: The official artist, promoter and venue routes, admitted coverage and a fresh September 20 registry search do not publish the executed contracts or clauses assigning final lineup authority. The page records each participant's statement without treating the general AP tour-control account as this tour's contract.

The AP URL was force-recaptured after its live article advanced beyond the pre-show revision. The new pin records the completed concert, no opener, later musicians, Sheeran's remarks and the demonstration.

CAIR-Philadelphia's September 17 Right-to-Know request is pinned with its scope and its express statement that the request does not presume what responsive records will show. No result was found through September 20.

needs_ledger.need: Earlier comparable Loop Tour lineup change
needs_ledger.plain: The admitted tour record, a fresh registry search and the stale supplemental LEANN index supplied no earlier comparable Loop Tour removal followed by supporting-artist departures, so no elapsed interval is stated.
The official schedule and venue records and a fresh registry search through September 20 do not identify supporting personnel for the remaining September 25 through November 7 dates.

needs_ledger.need: Messina Touring Group event statement on its own site
needs_ledger.plain: The promoter's current site was captured in capture-oneoff-20260920T062845Z and again through its canonical domain in capture-oneoff-20260920T063145Z. Neither saved page carried an event statement; Rolling Stone is admitted as the carrier of Messina's quoted statement.

needs_ledger.need: Robert Kraft statement on a first-party page
needs_ledger.plain: The Kraft Group overview and Israel philanthropy pages were captured in capture-oneoff-20260920T063145Z but did not carry the September 14 response. USA Today is admitted because it prints the full statement; AP and Rolling Stone independently carry portions.

The current artist and North America pages were captured in capture-oneoff-20260920T062845Z and capture-oneoff-20260920T063145Z, but their saved text layers did not expose the date rows. The official PDF, past-dates page and venue pages supply the fixed schedule record instead.

Spanish AP copies, repeated AP syndications, two Washington Post captures, and multiple USA Today retellings in the September 14, 15 and 20 candidate clusters were read for cluster identity but not admitted as separate lineages.
BBC and Al Jazeera video pages in the candidate rows did not add a recoverable passage beyond the admitted text records, so no video-only claim is used.
A CNBC resale-price report found in the census was not admitted because secondary asking prices do not provide a complete sales denominator and are outside the lineup record.
Three LEANN searches were run against news-articles-clean-v1. The index reported a September 7 vintage and returned no usable record for the September 14-19 event.
The already admitted AP donations record is now used in the What happened next detail layer for Macklemore's pledge, the six recipients and the separately reported Sheeran and Kraft commitments.

needs_ledger.need: Interrogation 2: Kraft-Sheeran call and named NFL owners
needs_ledger.plain: The Wall Street Journal article was captured in capture-oneoff-20260920T074821Z, pinned and used in the removal detail layer. Its anonymous sourcing does not resolve the unpublished contracts or communications.

needs_ledger.need: Interrogation 3: objecting stadiums and the two Hollywood dates
needs_ledger.plain: The admitted Rolling Stone record supplies the venue list and the eight-of-10 Macklemore count; the official schedule table shows the two Hollywood dates among all 10 remaining shows.

The cited USA Today account was already held in quarry-wire-scheduled-20260917T100020Z. The story uses the A-grade stage acts from the admitted Rolling Stone pin; additional slogans and remarks do not change the removal mechanism or lineup record.
The JTA explainer was captured in capture-oneoff-20260920T074821Z. Background on the song's title and lyrics does not change the event's lineup, authority dispute or outcome and was not admitted.

needs_ledger.need: Interrogation 6: petition text and later IAC reaction
needs_ledger.plain: The admitted Rolling Stone record establishes the petition and request to remove Macklemore. The cited JTA petition account was already held in capture-oneoff-20260920T074133Z; the later advocacy reaction was not needed to establish the decision.
The named ADL post was captured in capture-oneoff-20260920T074821Z. Advocacy reactions do not add a decision, contract term or lineup change beyond the admitted criticism and petition record.
The Guardian article was already held in quarry-wire-scheduled-20260914T160000Z. Pink's reaction does not alter the lineup decision, tour-control mechanism or the four recorded departures.
The admitted USA Today record prints Kraft's full statement. The story carries the decision and stated rationale; the detail layer points readers to the full saved statement.

The cited JTA background was captured in capture-oneoff-20260920T075234Z. Historical context behind Kraft's allegation is outside the bounded 2026 lineup event and is not used to adjudicate that allegation.

The 12-slide first-party statement is already pinned and admitted. The story uses its removal, venue-pressure and Sheeran-conversation passages while the reader model grades the remaining passages below the story view.
The Rolling Stone Australia account was captured in capture-oneoff-20260920T074821Z. A political reaction does not establish authority, contract terms or a lineup change.

needs_ledger.need: Interrogation 13: CAIR legal claim and letter campaign
needs_ledger.plain: The first-party CAIR-Philadelphia page is already pinned and admitted. The story uses the records request and its express limits; the unadjudicated legal claim and sign-on campaign do not establish a result.

The New York Times article was captured in capture-oneoff-20260920T074821Z, pinned and used in the outcome detail layer for the delayed start and fuller remarks. AP remains the A-grade event outcome in the story view.

The Rolling Stone Australia account was captured in capture-oneoff-20260920T074821Z, pinned and used in the withdrawal detail layer. It records Rowe's later defense of Sheeran without changing his withdrawal.
The cited Rolling Stone article was captured in capture-oneoff-20260920T074821Z. Casey was not a tour participant, and his industry opinion does not establish this tour's unpublished authority.

needs_ledger.need: Interrogation 17: tickets, refunds and empty seats
needs_ledger.plain: The cited Digital Music News report was captured in capture-oneoff-20260920T074821Z. Like the already found CNBC resale report, secondary asking-price changes lack a complete sales denominator and do not establish attendance or refunds.

The accepted state label remains the headline, but the dek and The catch immediately distinguish the four roles. The admitted AP record expressly calls Rowe and Lukas Graham replacements for the remaining U.S. dates.

The cited IBTimes UK article was captured in capture-oneoff-20260920T074821Z. The admitted first-party statement and AP role record establish Beoga's departure and in-set role; collaboration history does not change the event.

The named outlet cluster was compared with the admitted lineages and the interrogation captures. New mechanism and outcome passages were admitted from the Wall Street Journal, New York Times and Rolling Stone follow-up; duplicate retellings and reactions were not added as separate lineages.

sources_admitted.evidence: Twenty-four primary, official and coverage records have registry capture runs, repository pins, text siblings, recomputed hashes and byte-exact quote spans.

derived_numbers_computed.evidence: The data module computes 27 official North American dates, 10 dates after September 14, two MetLife dates and four departing supporting acts, and carries the sourced eight scheduled Macklemore appearances.

outlet_claims_verified.evidence: Thirteen coverage records were checked against the artist statements, official schedule, venue records and CAIR request; the missing contract and first-party promoter and Kraft routes remain typed in the needs ledger.

section_grammar.evidence: The story follows the reader model in order: What happened, Why Macklemore was removed, The catch, Why the other artists left, What happened next, What we do not know yet, and The records. Each question-tree section has more than two passages.

live_elements_guarded.evidence: The page contains no live element. The official schedule and venue pages carry fixed capture vintages.
